title: Overlay QR smart card response (PRF-02, catalogue module #10)
description: The overlay/browser-source-facing read. Two fields, 12.7-bounded: destination and label. No card id, no timestamp and no enabled flag -- the underlying read (app_private.list_overlay_qr_smart_card, migration 0144) returns a row ONLY when the card's own is_enabled is true, so the row's presence already carries the toggle's true state. A disabled card and a channel that has never configured one answer with the identical null.
